editorial:
Ever feel like your life is just a loop of boring work and fake smiles? You will totally relate to the main guy here. He is in his forties and just hits a wall where he cannot take the loveless family or the dull job anymore. He decides to ditch everything and just walk away to find some real meaning. The vibe is very quiet and reflective, focusing on that feeling of being lost in your own life. When he meets a younger woman, things get interesting because she does not just give him her heart; she challenges him to prove he has actually changed.

The acting is great because it feels like real people talking, not a scripted play. It moves a bit slow, which might bore some of you, but it helps you feel his loneliness. If you enjoy stories about starting over, you should definitely check this out. Since it is an older film, you might want to look for a high-quality stream on Prime Video or rent it on Apple TV to get the best picture. If you are a movie collector, adding the Blu-ray to your shelf is a solid move for a rainy day.
endingExplained: In the end, the man realizes that running away from his old life was not enough to fix his inner pain. After being tested by the young woman, he understands that true happiness comes from honesty and accepting yourself. He does not get a perfect fairy tale ending, but he finds a sense of peace. He finally stops pretending and learns how to live for himself instead of for other people.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about mid-life crises and finding yourself.
